---
title: "Module 5: Introduction to Apache Spark"
---

## Overview

Apache Spark is the main processing framework in this course. This module runs a first Spark application, compares Spark with pandas on a large CSV file, and introduces Spark's language APIs, from low-level RDDs to DataFrames.

## Hands-on

::: {.callout-important}
## Common error: Java version
Spark notebooks fail with `UnsupportedClassVersionError` or `Java gateway process exited` when Java is
missing or too old. PySpark 4 needs **Java 17 or later**. See
[PySpark setup → Troubleshooting](../../pyspark-setup.qmd#troubleshooting).
:::
